Calculate the likelihood components for the joint model

Source: R/common_functions.R
build_copula_pair_cache.Rd

This function calculates the marginal and copula log likelihoods and components for the joint model by organizing response data by margin and subject for efficient pair-based copula calculations.

Usage

build_copula_pair_cache(response, response_margin, response_subject)

Arguments

response

A numeric vector of response values.

response_margin

A numeric vector indicating the margin (time) for each response.

response_subject

A numeric vector indicating the subject for each response.

Value

A list containing:

log_lik

A named vector with marginal, copula, and joint log-likelihoods.

margin_d

A numeric vector of marginal densities.

copula_d

A numeric vector of copula densities.

margin_p

A numeric vector of marginal distribution function values.

Fx_1_2

A matrix of marginal distribution function values for pairs of margins.

order_copula

A matrix indicating the order of margins and subjects for copula calculations.

margin_deriv

A list of marginal derivatives.

order_copula

A matrix indicating the order of margins and subjects for copula calculations.
